async def act(page):
    # Hover over the Reports link to expand its menu
    reports_link = page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name=' Reports')
    await reports_link.hover()
    # Wait a moment for the menu to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click the Bestsellers link within the expanded menu
    # Based on the tree, Bestsellers is under a menu with other product-related links
    bestsellers_link = page.get_by_role('menu').filter(has=page.get_by_role('link', name='Bestsellers')).get_by_role('link', name='Bestsellers')
    await bestsellers_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
